statement:
The post record will show whether SM-77 publicly names Halden Bank before its November launch, which determines whether it may be published or must be held.
The record confirms that SM-77 names Halden Bank, so the studio’s agreement requires holding it despite the record’s separate note that the client is happy to be named.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer asserts "the studio's agreement requires holding it despite the record's separate note that the client is happy to be named," i.e., the confidentiality-cleared field contradicts the stated embargo.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
